Help & Store Policies

Clear information about ordering, delivery and support.

Frequently asked questions

How do I place an order?
Choose a product, add it to your cart, sign in with Google at checkout, enter your delivery details and place your order using Cash on Delivery.

When is my order confirmed?
New orders first show “Verifying by Admin”. The store owner reviews each order and then marks it “Order Verified”.

Can I cancel an order?
Customers cannot cancel an order after placing it. Contact support if you need help. The store owner may cancel an order.

How can I track my order?
Open My Account → My Orders or Track Order. The status updates as the store processes your order.

Which payment methods are available?
Cash on Delivery is available. UPI is shown as Coming Soon and is not currently enabled.

Shipping, cancellation & returns

Delivery charges are shown with each product and in your cart before checkout. The estimated dispatch information, where available, is shown on the product page. Orders are reviewed by the store owner before dispatch. Customers cannot cancel placed orders through the website. For delivery, damaged-item or return questions, contact COCO support at WhatsApp 7306906227.

Privacy policy

COCO uses your Google sign-in identity and the delivery details you provide to process and track orders. Order details are visible to the store owner for fulfilment and to the signed-in customer who placed the order. Do not enter payment passwords or other sensitive credentials in the website.

Terms & conditions

Prices, discounts and delivery charges are displayed before an order is placed. Orders are subject to review by the store owner. Cash on Delivery is the currently available payment method. UPI is not enabled and is displayed only as Coming Soon. Customers cannot cancel an order from the website after placing it.

Need help?

Contact COCO support for order or product assistance.
